root_cause_label: Agent claimed task completion at step 13 without evidence that the distribution build (step 12) succeeded or that runtime validation of the patch was performed, leaving the fix unverified
one_sentence_failure_summary: After correctly patching FileUploadHandler.java and starting a full distribution build+test sequence, the agent issued a premature completion signal without waiting for or confirming the build and runtime validation outputs, resulting in an unverified fix.
t_err_evidence: Step 13 runs only 'echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT' with no prior confirmation that step 12's distribution build or runtime path-traversal tests completed successfully; the step 12 output is truncated at '== Building Flink distribution with fix ==' with no BUILD_OK or PASS signals.
t_commit_evidence: Step 13 is the final step; the agent claims done here without any further actions possible, locking in the unverified failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent issued a completion claim at step 13 (echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT) before confirming that the full Flink distribution rebuild and the runtime path-traversal test suite from step 12 had actually succeeded. The step 12 command output showed only the start of the build with no terminal PASS/FAIL signals, yet the agent proceeded to claim completion.
forewarning_evidence: Step 10 had quoting issues causing the diff invocation to fail ('diff: No such file or directory') and the build never ran. Step 12 output was truncated after '== Building Flink distribution with fix ==' with no BUILD_OK, cluster start, or test results visible.
